channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Heraldry Add-On
item.description: Adds 18 new Heraldry patterns in 11 colors, with support for both banners and capes.

item.title: JavaCo (TM) Patent MotorCar (Automobile)
item.description: The JavaCo Motorcar only comes in black, sorry. You can paint it yourself though. Also, other stuff.

item.title: BetterQueue
item.description: Various Queue improvements (modlist before queue, position memory and recovery, manual queue manip.)

item.title: Remember It
item.description: Remembers where you have been and draws it onto your Frontier's Map, a little more each visit.

item.title: LTO Black Smith +
item.description: Toolsmith + Smithing Plus + Weaponsmith and more — a full blacksmithing overhaul.

item.title: Insulated Japanese Architecture
item.description: The same Japanese Archictecture but with insolation and more wood types.

item.title: Practical Electricity
item.description: Early-1800s DC electricity: real circuits from a vinegar cell to a coal-fired power station.

item.title: Firepits Show Fuel
item.description: Firepits now visually show what fuel they're burning.

item.title: Monkey Mischief
item.description: Adds monkeys to the game.

item.title: Feverstone Wilds
item.description: Feverstone Wilds is a fantasy mod mixed with realism that can help you or challenge you.

item.title: Smart TV
item.description: This mod adds a flat screen wall mounted tv that is resizable. Only available in the creative menu

item.title: VSCN 文明模拟主模组
item.description: For Chinese community servers only（Civilization Simulation）

item.title: Uranium Expanded (Metals and Tools)
item.description: Adds uranium based alloys, adds uranium glass, tools and uranium fever.

item.title: WOO Fantasy Additions
item.description: A mod focused on bringing the lore of the Oldwood into Vintage Story.

item.title: LTO Lib plus
item.description: Library for LTO mods

item.title: Food Preservation & Display
item.description: Taxidermy for food.

item.title: Backrooms: Survival Story
item.description: You wake up in the Backrooms with nothing. Can you survive?

item.title: Syrup and CO2
item.description: Adds cola and soda as well as a carbonation system to the game!

item.title: Floral Zones + Airship Compat
item.description: Adds FZ variants for Airships from the Airships mod.

item.title: Floral Zones + Shipwright Compatibility
item.description: Adds Floral Zones wood variants to Shipwright boats.

item.title: Floral Zones + Immersive Fibercraft
item.description: Adds Floral Zone wood variants to Immersive Fibercraft.

item.title: Floral Zones + Purposeful Storage Compat
item.description: Adds floral zones variants for purposeful storage

item.title: Komet - Performance Mod
item.description: Komet is an awesome performance mod!

item.title: Floral Zones + Food Shelves Compatibility Addon
item.description: Adds compatibility between Floral Zones and Food Shelves (wood)

item.title: Fiddleheads
item.description: Fiddlehead Ferns - Harvest wild furled fronds and use them in meals as any other vegetable

item.title: Solaria's Solace Server Tweaks
item.description: A bunch of fixes and additions for the server.

item.title: CoB Client Files [1]
item.description: Required to join the awesome Conquest of Blocks (aka 'CoB') multiplayer realm.

item.title: CoB Client Files [2]
item.description: Required to join the awesome Conquest of Blocks (aka 'CoB') multiplayer realm.

item.title: TURBOJOIN
item.description: (hopefully) speeds up server load time

item.title: XIT
item.description: Recipe browser, crafting autofill, inventory sorting, container search and hotbar refill.
